 zdx monitor · read-only dashboard

  Everywhere
    1-8  tab  ← →           switch tabs
    j k  ↑ ↓  wheel         move
    pgup pgdn  ctrl+u/d     page
    gg  G                   top, bottom
    r                       refresh this tab now
    ?                       this help (esc closes)
    q  ctrl+c               quit

  Tabs
    Agents  ↵               open the selected run's transcript
    Threads  ↵  t           open transcript · all threads or workers only
    Usage  Q  [ ]           fetch quotas now · token window 1/7/30/90/365 days
    Logs  l / esc [ ] G     level · filter text · clear · older/newer day · follow
    Config  [ ]             previous/next workspace

  Transcript
    n p  tab                next/previous tool
    ↵                       tool detail (output, input)
    t                       expand/collapse thinking
    i                       timing (trajectory)
    G                       follow new activity
    esc                     back

  Connection
    state                   ● connected
    project root            /Users/example/Documents
    ZDX home                /Users/example/.zdx
    socket                  /Users/example/.zdx/run/engine.sock
    protocol                2
    views root              /Users/example/Documents
    capabilities            thread_views, monitor_views
    tracked threads         3 (threads the service holds state for)
    cli fallback            off

  Data sources
    Views come from the engine socket; Services and Jobs from `zdx service status --json`
    and `zdx jobs list --scheduler --json`; Logs from $ZDX_HOME/logs. Nothing here writes.
    Not here yet: service start/stop/restart, bg kill, job model edit (use the zdx CLI),
    full thread browse and filters, config edits.







 esc close  j/k scroll                                                                                                                                                                      ● connected
